SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 2 AND ts_doy >= 230 AND ts_doy <= 244
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy as doy, 
  cls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 AND fish_date_doy >= 235 AND fish_date_doy <= 244
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
